purpose: Exact finite-domain certification on a selected predeclared d=9 trained Boolean network, beyond a raw global spectral bound if possible.
eligibility: The frozen training record has every signed training output strictly above 1/2; this numerical eligibility screen will be distinguished from exact verification of the chosen network.
selection: After all earlier model outcomes are available, choose the first model in model order for which one of the primary constants (ascending order) has all 512 finite-tube tests passing but the raw global spectral sufficient bound failing. If no such pair exists in all six models, repeat at c=.001/H. If still none, select the first eligible model and smallest constant for which all 512 numerical tests pass, without claiming improvement over the matrix bound.
proof_attempt: Compute exact rational global operator-norm bounds and interval clean outputs on all 512 vertices. Use clipped global output enclosures where sufficient, then exact reachable-tube interval certificates on remaining vertices, within the research deadline.
outcomes: Retain every selected vertex result, including unresolved cases. Claim a global finite-domain certificate only if every one of the 512 vertices is rigorously certified. Independently interval-check all 400 training margins as a byproduct.
scope: Exact stored dyadic weights, all Boolean input vertices, simultaneous postactivation/output disturbances, primary score clip at +/-1/2. No input perturbation; no claim beyond this finite domain unless a separate global matrix proof applies.
